tier1.headline: Your Data Shared for Ads
tier1.quote: To the extent that we share your information with certain advertising, marketing, or analytics vendors, this can be considered a “sale” or “share” in certain U.S. States, which you may have the right to opt out of.

tier1.headline: Your Face Data Collected
tier1.quote: For example, the photo that you upload to your public profile, or a default image if you haven’t uploaded one, is your G lobally R ecognized Avatar, or Gravatar — get it?

tier1.headline: Your Credit Checked for Jobs
tier1.quote: We may also collect additional information about you during the process, like background and credit checks (in applicable jurisdictions and only for certain job roles).

tier1.headline: Your Data Trains AI/ML
tier1.quote: If you are a job applicant, we may also collect technical indicators such as VPN usage and IP addresses to support the integrity and security of our hiring practices.

tier1.headline: Your Info Collected Without Account
tier1.quote: Third-party services may also give us information, like mailing addresses for individuals who are not yet our users (but we hope will be!).

tier2.headline: Your DNT Signals Ignored
tier2.quote: At this time, Automattic does not respond to “do not track” signals across all of our Services.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Internally
tier2.quote: We may disclose information about you to our subsidiaries and independent contractors who need the information to help us provide our Services or process the information on our behalf.

tier2.headline: Your Data Retained on Backups
tier2.quote: After the thirty days are up, the deleted content may remain on our backups and caches until purged.

tier2.headline: Your Precise Location Collected
tier2.quote: We may also collect information about your precise location via our mobile apps (like when you post a photograph with location information) if you allow us to do so through your mobile device operating system’s permissions.

tier2.headline: Your Behavior Analyzed
tier2.quote: We collect information about the actions that site administrators and users perform on a site using our WordPress.com or Jetpack services — in other words, who did what and when (e.g., [WordPress.com username] deleted “[title of post]” at [time/date]).

tier2.headline: Your Ads Are Personalized
tier2.quote: As part of our advertising program, we and our users do use cookies to share certain device identifiers and information about your browsing activities with our advertising partners, and those advertising partners may use that information to show you personalized ads on some of our users’ sites and some of our own.

tier2.headline: Your Data Transferred Internationally
tier2.quote: Because Automattic’s Services are offered worldwide, the information about you that we process when you use the Services in the EU or the UK may be used, stored, and/or accessed by individuals operating outside the European Economic Area (EEA) or the UK who work for us, other members of our group of companies, or third-party data processors.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Without Warrant
tier2.quote: We may disclose information about you when we believe in good faith that disclosure is reasonably necessary to protect the property or rights of Automattic, third parties, or the public at large.
